# Mercy Speaks Digital

> Mercy Speaks Digital builds conversion websites for growing businesses: new websites and redesigns that explain your business clearly and make it easy for visitors to call or request a quote. We also offer Website Care & Optimization plans, and an AI Receptionist offered only as a limited pilot.

Key facts: Website packages: Starter $997 (up to 5 pages, 2 revision rounds), Business $1,997 (up to 10 pages, 2 revision rounds, recommended), Premium from $3,500 (pages by approved scope, 3 revision rounds). Website Care: $79/month (Care) and $149/month (Care Plus). The AI Receptionist pilot is limited and by invitation; it answers calls routed to it and captures messages and service requests for the business's team to review. It does not confirm appointments. Contact: don@mercyspeaksdigital.com · (832) 981-3123.

## Website package details

Every package includes mobile-first design checked on phones and desktops, tap-to-call to your existing number, a contact form, a Google Map embed or link, basic on-page SEO (page titles, meta descriptions, local business schema), a private preview before launch, launch to your domain, 14 days of defect fixes, and a handoff.

Add-ons: extra page $150; logo design $250 when separately scoped; copywriting $100 per page; extra revision round $150; Spanish-language version +40%, subject to scope and page count.

Payment: 50% to begin, 50% before launch. Quotes are valid for 30 calendar days.

Timeline: 10–15 business days of active Mercy Speaks production time after the initial payment and all required starting assets are received. The delivery clock pauses while Mercy Speaks is waiting for client content, assets, credentials/access, feedback, revisions, or approvals.

Hosting and domain are not included; the client owns both accounts.
